title: Concept: TLS verification disabled (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, VERIFY_NONE disables a TLS authenticity check. Without verification, encryption still runs but against whoever answers — including an attacker. The remedy is restoring verification (VERIFY_PEER with a CA store).
applicability: ruby TLS clients and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Machine-in-the-middle interception of all traffic on the connection; HIGH severity.
